name: Ag Processing Solutions, Inc.
description: Ag Processing Solutions is a team of engineers and fabricators specializing in the design and construction of agricultural processing facilities tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. In addition to our design and consulting services, we operate an 11,000 sq. ft. processing facility where we offer toll cleaning, milling and pelleting for nearly any commodity under the sun. We also specialize in the fabrication and design of custom stainless steel belt conveyors for your agricultural processing facility. Whether you're looking to build a new agricultural processing plant, need help with optimizing your current facility or need custom-engineered solutions, our team has the expertise and resources to assist in your journey.
